headline: John Adams moves into the White House
post_facts: The first president to live there
Abigail dried laundry in the East Room

scenes.text: [calmly] On this day, in eighteen hundred... John Adams became the first president to live in the White House.

scenes.label: John Adams
scenes.caption: Portrait by Gilbert Stuart
scenes.text: [thoughtfully] Back then, it was the unfinished President's House.

scenes.label: since the cornerstone was laid in 1792
scenes.text: [calmly] Work had begun eight years earlier.

scenes.label: Abigail Adams
scenes.caption: Portrait by Gilbert Stuart
scenes.text: [softly] Abigail later hung laundry in the empty East Room.

scenes.title: His blessing lives on
scenes.text: [thoughtfully] His prayer, that only honest and wise men rule there, is now carved into a mantel.
